venue_reference: Admiralspalast (historic theatre / concert hall, Mitte, Berlin — Friedrichstraße 101, 10117 Berlin)

identity.notes: admiralspalast.de (the venue's naive domain) 301-redirects to atgentertainment.de, the operator group's corporate site, not this venue's own presence — that redirect target was rejected as the official_url for exactly that reason. admiralspalast.theater is the venue's own dedicated first-party domain: its retained <title> is 'Admiralspalast, Berlin', its homepage meta description names the venue directly ('Im Admiralspalast Berlin erwartet das Publikum ein vielfältiges Live-Programm...'), and every sampled event detail page repeats the identical retained address block 'Admiralspalast Berlin / Friedrichstr. 101 / 10117 Berlin' — consistent with the venue's well-known real-world address in Mitte, Berlin.

site_classification.platform: Contao Open Source CMS (retained <meta name="generator" content="Contao Open Source CMS"> on every sampled page). No JSON-LD Event data, no ICS/iCal link, no WordPress signals (no wp-content/wp-json), no Fourvenues script, no Sanity config — event data is exposed only as static, semantically-classed server-rendered HTML (event list cards + per-event 'Termine & Tickets' blocks with dedicated evDay/evMJ/evWdT spans).

start_date.notes: Re-assessed against a full, freshly-retained byte-faithful copy of the events-overview page (ev-events-overview-full, 112 real event cards): each card's own <div id="eventzeitraum"> states a single, complete run-start date directly as 'ab DD.MM.YY' (e.g. 'ab 01.11.26' for Cem Adrian) — day, month, and year are all directly present in one field, only the year abbreviated to two digits, exactly the same DD/MM/YY short-form pattern this project already classifies as DIRECT_SOURCE for ausland-berlin-01 (research/source-investigations/ausland-berlin-01/investigation.json), not a combination of two separate retained context pieces. Independently cross-validated against the event detail page's own 'Termine & Tickets' evDay ('01') + evMJ ('Nov 2026') spans (ev-event-detail, ev-event-detail-cem-adrian-full), which yield the identical 2026-11-01 for this same event. The committed collector (ingestion/admiralspalast/observation-adapter.mjs) uses the events-overview page's own 'ab DD.MM.YY' field as its data path, decoded via the fixed 20YY convention documented in code; this is proven offline and deterministically in tests/admiralspalast.test.mjs against the retained fixtures/admiralspalast-berlin/events-page.html.

time.notes: The same event row's own So, 20:00 states the local time-of-day directly as a literal substring ('20:00') of one retained element — no combination with a separate element needed. No UTC offset or IANA timezone is stated anywhere on the page, so this is honestly a floating local time, not upgraded to a UTC instant. The committed collector (ingestion/admiralspalast/observation-adapter.mjs) deliberately does not fetch every event's own detail page to harvest this per-event time-of-day at scale — it uses only the bounded events-overview page (title + run-start date for all 112 real events in one retained fixture), so its own Observations honestly carry DATE_ONLY certainty with no time field populated, even though time is separately PROVEN achievable from a sampled detail page as recorded here.

end.notes: No end time or end date is exposed anywhere on the retained event-list or event-detail pages for the sampled event.

venue_location.notes: This is a single-venue site (unlike e.g. Razzmatazz's multiple numbered rooms) — every sampled event detail page carries the identical retained 'Adresse Theater' address block naming the venue and its full postal address directly, on the same page as the event's own date/time data. No cross-page or cross-section combination is needed.

source_record_id.notes: No numeric id is exposed on the venue's own pages. Each event's own detail-page URL slug ('/veranstaltung/{slug}.html') is this source's own permanent, source-authored path for that event, directly stated as the href on every list card and reused as the canonical URL of the detail page itself — the same documented URL-slug-as-source_record_id strategy already established for moog-barcelona-01 and LAV (ingestion/lav/discovery.mjs). Confirmed unique across all 112 real events on the retained events-overview page (ev-events-overview-full) and reproduced offline in tests/admiralspalast.test.mjs (every source_record_id in the batch is asserted unique).

event_url.notes: Each event card's own href, directly stated, and independently confirmed by fetching it (HTTP 200, ev-event-detail).

price.notes: No price is stated on the venue's own event list or detail pages for the sampled event. The detail page's own 'Tickets' button links out to a third-party ticketing site (eventim.de) where price presumably appears — that is Eventim's own page, not this source's own first-party data, and was not treated as this source's price per the policy's third-party-authority rule.

blockers.description: No explicit UTC offset or IANA timezone is stated on any retained page; 'time' is honestly a floating local (presumed Europe/Berlin) time, not a proven UTC instant. The committed collector does not currently harvest per-event time-of-day at all (see field_assessment.time notes) — Observations from this adapter carry DATE_ONLY certainty, never a fabricated time or timezone.
